items.title: 68004_Howard McGhee oral history interview
items.q: I liked the way Gerald writes... I copied after them, too, in a sense.

ctx.x: ...and bands. Who did you like that you might say you picked up on certain things that you could use?
Well, Jimmy Lunceford's band. I liked his band because I liked the way Gerald writes...
